text: Easy. Hands where I can see them.
...Huh. Walked out of the dark with nothing but the clothes on your back, did you? I've seen that look before. The Gates spit people out like that sometimes.
Garrick. I hunt the roads, what's left of them, and teach the butts here when I'm back.
The things that crawl out of the Gates eat anything with four legs. Two weeks out and all I've got is a pair of hares. There are mouths in this city waiting on me.
Tears in the air. Some call them wounds. Step through one and you're somewhere else. Somewhere dead, full of things that want you dead too.
The Guild ranks them like it ranks its people, F at the bottom. Nobody's come back from the high ones to say what's in them.
The Guild's training yard. Highmourn's the capital, the last city with walls worth the name. Work, coin, a bed if you're lucky.
But nothing's free in here, stranger.
Meat. Four pork chops. The pigs still root around the fields and the forest edges, if you've got the stomach to run them down.
Bring me four and I'll see you right.
Good. Don't wander too far after dark. And if you see a Gate, don't go poking at it alone.
Good meat. You've got some use in you after all.
And stranger? The Gates near the roads are F-rank. Weak, they say. Don't believe it. Take friends.
